name: Film and Media Studies (Production Track)
notes: The film and media studies BA has two tracks - Theory and Production - each twelve courses. This entry is the PRODUCTION track; the theory track is a separate entry (major-fmst-theory-ba). The first four requirements are identical in both tracks; the tracks differ only in the last two.
DEPARTMENT CODE: the major page writes 'FMS 131' and 'FMS 132', but the registrar's catalog prefix is FMST. All codes here are translated to FMST.

CATEGORY LISTS ARE TERM-DEPENDENT - NEEDS VERIFICATION: the department's course-categories page lists only the courses offered in the captured term, so the history, international/transnational, analysis and production groups below are a snapshot, not the department's full category membership. Several of the numbers it lists (FMST 107, 203, 235, 236, 243, 245, 270, 274, 277, 288) are not in the 2025-26 catalog under those numbers, and FMST 224/245 are rotating topics slots whose current catalog titles differ from the ones on the categories page. Confirm the current category list with the department before planning around it.

PRODUCTION LIST IS TIGHT: the department published exactly five production courses for the captured term (FMST 161, 203, 205, 243, 260) and the track requires five production courses, so the group below has no slack at all. The real category rotates - treat this group as a starting point and confirm the current production offerings with the department.
Students who are double majoring, earning a dual degree, or taking a minor or cluster in a related area should review the overlap policy before selecting their courses.

NEEDS VERIFICATION - UPPER-LEVEL WRITING: neither the major page nor the course-categories page states a ULW policy, and the 2025-26 catalog has no W-suffixed FMST courses, so none is encoded. Confirm with the program how you will satisfy the College requirement.

GROUP ORDER MATTERS HERE: the five production courses are assigned before the three analysis courses, because FMST 205 and FMST 243 sit in both categories and the production list has no spare options.
